hero.heading: Make your lab modern
hero.body: Junto Technologies modernizes chemistry labs. It tracks what a lab holds and designs ways to connect older instruments to lab systems. It also applies machine learning and statistics to biomedical questions.

team.heading: Work directly with the builder
team.body: Shaun works with companies to understand their operations, then designs tools that fit how their teams work.

members.name: Shaun Porwal
members.bio: Shaun builds **biomedical AI systems** across agentic workflows, survival modeling, and biology models. Shaun recently worked as a **founding engineer at a biotech startup** and previously built clinical ML tools at **Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center**, creating [dcurves](https://github.com/MSKCC-Epi-Bio/dcurves). **Hands-on chemistry experience** spans labs and manufacturing across the U.S., Taiwan, and Japan. Degrees: biomedical engineering and biomedical data science.

contactBand.heading: Have a lab problem to solve?
contactBand.body: Write to Shaun, or book a 30 minute call.
